title: Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories
author: Allison
description: Starting December 8, 2026, GitHub will turn off Dependabot alerts on most repositories with no activity in the past year. Their existing alerts are archived, not deleted, and you can… The post Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Starting December 8, 2026, GitHub will turn off Dependabot alerts on most repositories with no activity in the past year. Their existing alerts are archived, not deleted, and you can restore them at any time.
takeaways: What counts as activity GitHub counts any of these as activity: Pushing to any branch or tag Creating the repository Turning on Dependabot alerts Turn alerts back on Any push to the repository automatically turns Dependabot alerts back on.
Either way, GitHub restores the archived alerts, and the one-year clock starts over.
Keep alerts on regardless of activity GitHub won’t turn off alerts on repositories with an enforced security configuration that enables Dependabot alerts.
